newsitem.title: USA: Audio King December sales edge higher.
newsitem.headline: Audio King December sales edge higher.

text.p: Audio King Corp said Thursday sales for the month of December reached $8.4 million, up slightly from sales of $8.1 million in December of 1995.
The company said sales for the fiscal year to date were $35.3 million, compared with $35 million in the comparable six months in 1995.
"It is particularly gratifying to produce positive sales results during a time our industry is struggling," Gary Thorne, Audio King president and chief executive, said.
Audio King operates 11 consumer electronics stores in Minnesota, South Dakota and Iowa.
